I sat in the front seat
When later in life she would appear
Inside, Storyland was mobbed with people
The first few days of July
The next day at Storyland was slow
‘Do you want to go have a drink?’
The next morning it was eighty degrees
I sat out there by myself that day
On Isabelle’s desk was a picture
The camp was a Baptist one
I won a sword drill competition.
Somehow I didn’t think I’d be the only one
I was Howie’s girlfriend for a year
After college, I did go back to Horsehearts
